quotes.text: You can't trust code that you did not totally create yourself.
quotes.author: Ken Thompson
quotes.source: Reflections on Trusting Trust, 1984 Turing Award Lecture

quotes.text: SOC 2 compliance is proof that you filled out a lot of paperwork, not proof that you're secure.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The best time to learn about security is before you get hacked. The second best time is after. The worst time is never.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The best security practice is assuming you've already been breached.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: Every new dependency is a potential vulnerability. Audit them like you audit your employees.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The best time to think about security is before you ship. The second best time is after you've been breached.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: The most dangerous thing in the world is a programmer who thinks they understand security.
quotes.author: based

quotes.text: It seems ridiculous that there would be consumer demand to unlock a car from a phone in the first place. What is the point of all this infrastructure and complexity? So you can be just a little bit more lazy. This sort of tech is both a vulnerability and a waste of human resources and ingenuity.
quotes.author: everdrive
quotes.source: Hacker News — Unlocking any car from X brand in most of the world
quotes.extraction_note: Pithy anti-complexity takedown — 'all this infrastructure so you can be a little more lazy' is a perfect grug-brained observation.

quotes.text: Automakers failed security the moment their cars connected to the internet.
quotes.author: NooneAtAll5
quotes.source: Hacker News — Unlocking any car from X brand in most of the world
quotes.extraction_note: One-liner with a clean thesis — blunt, quotable, and immediately debatable.
